original_prompt: Perform a 2D Bernard Cell simulation using OpenFOAM buoyantFoam solver. The computational domain spans 9 m x 1 m in x and y, meshed with 90 x 10 cells, with a single cell of 2 m thickness in z and empty front and back patches. The simulation begins at t=0 seconds and runs until t = 1000 seconds with a time step of 1 second, and results are written at intervals of every 50 seconds. The bottom wall (floor) has a temperature of 310 K and the top wall (ceiling) has a temperature of 295 K; the side walls are adiabatic (zero-gradient temperature).
adaptation: 源heRhoThermo+Boussinesq明确限定成标准不可压缩Boussinesq，alpha=nu/Pr；将不相容均匀横流改为公开流函数生成的无散且无滑移相容扰动；修复wall组未在网格定义的问题，对全部四壁施加无滑移；压力改为明确定义的去静水压零均值规范，不宣称逐字复现源可压缩实现。
numerical_controls: 原deltaT/Co/软件与算法不约束考生；保留物理输出时刻。
